title: Describe and Draw · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Describe and Draw · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: One player draws a simple arrangement of three shapes, keeping it hidden from a partner. The lead describes the arrangement without showing it while the partner draws. The partner's drawing preserves the shapes and their relative positions. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Describe and Draw, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner's drawing preserves the shapes and their relative positions.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The partner's drawing preserves the shapes and their relative positions.
